questions.question: The Ganga-Brahmaputra basin lies between _____ latitudes.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**10°N and 30°N.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ganga-Brahmaputra basin lies between** 10°N and 30°N latitudes.**

 
• The Ganges and Brahmaputra and their tributaries together form the 'Ganges-Brahmaputra basin' in the Indian subcontinent.
 
• The vast delta of the Sundarbans and the vast Gangetic plain are found here. Where the dense population is found.
 
• This basin is very useful for farming, mainly paddy, maize, sorghum, and millet are cultivated.
 
• Sundarbans forest is famous for the 'Mangrove forest'.
 
• Gokhur Lake or Ox-bow lake is a common feature in the plains.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Latitude is the angle that ranges from 0 degrees to 90 degrees.
 
• Latitude is imaginary lines that are horizontal.
 
• In India, the southernmost latitudes are 8 degrees and 4 minutes.
 
• 'Cape Camorin' in Kanyakumari is considered to be the southernmost point of India.
 
• The distance between latitudes is equal from the equator to the poles.
 
• Longitude is imaginary lines that are vertical.
 
• Longitude meets at the North and south poles.
 
• The distance between Longitude is not equal from the equator to the poles.
 
• It is minimum at poles and maximum at the equator.

questions.question: Which part of the soil contains humus?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**A-horizon**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****A. Horizon or Surface soil** 

__
 
• It is the part of the topsoil.
 
• In this layer, organic matter is mixed with mineral matter.
 
• It is the layer of mineral soil with the most organic matter accumulation and soil life.
 
• Nutrients like iron, aluminium, clay, and organic matter are sometimes dissolved and carried out in this layer.
 
• This layer is depleted of (eluviated of) iron, clay, aluminium, organic compounds, and other soluble constituents.
 
• When depletion is pronounced, a lighter-coloured “E” subsurface soil horizon is apparent at the base of the “A” horizon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Soil Profile: 

 
• It is the vertical section of soil from all its horizons. 
 
• There are different types of soil, each with its own set of characteristics.
 
• It is made of layers, or horizons (O, A, E, B, C, R). 
 
• Put the horizons together, and they form a soil profile.
 
• Most soil profiles cover the earth as 2 main layers Topsoil and Subsoil.
 
• Most soils have three major horizons (A, B, C) and some have an organic horizon (O).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ac5af8f6ec28d31d53a9d31b84cc424c86676e70e20fae8e0fd0a9063c47552.png] ​

questions.question: Sponges belong to phylum ______ of the animal kingdom.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Porifera.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Sponges belong to the phylum Porifera.
 
• These are primitive multicellular animals. The study of sponges is known as Parazoology.
 
• Sponges are mostly irregular in shape.
 
• They generally exhibit asymmetry or, in some cases, radial symmetry.
 
• Sponges have a cellular level of organisation and with two germ layers i.e. Diploblastic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Echinodermata** are exclusively marine organisms. Sea stars, sea cucumbers, sea urchins, sand dollars, and brittle stars are all examples of echinoderms.
 
• **Aschelminthes** are commonly known as roundworms. They are characterized by the presence of a pseudocoelom.
 
• **Mollusca **is the second-largest animal phylum. They are terrestrial or aquatic.

questions.question: Which of the following is a dance form from the state of Uttarakhand?
questions.solution:

__
 
• Choliya dance is the sword dance, meant to depict the martial art traditions of the Kumaoni tribe.
 
• This dance form is as old as a thousand years, and it is performed during the local Rajput weddings. 
 
• The Choliya dancers are equipped with swords and shields, regional brass instruments including Turi and Ransing, and percussion instruments like dhol and damaru, etc.
 
• The dancers dress like the Kumaon warriors and engage in mock sword fights with duly synchronised twists and turns of the body.​

• **Rouf **is performed with the intriguing footwork carefully resonating with one another.
 
 
• Rouf dance is the most important and famous folk dance form of Kashmir Valley.
 
 
 
• **Kutiyattam**, Sanskrit theatre, which is practised in Kerala, is one of India’s oldest living theatrical traditions.

questions.question: Ancient Indian manuscripts were usually written on palm leaves or the bark of the _____ tree, which grows in the Himalayas.

questions.question: The size of the pupil of the eye is controlled by the _____.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**iris**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **iris** regulates the amount of light entering the eyes.
 
• Iris is the **coloured part of the eye that gives pigment to the eye.**
 
• It is attached to ciliary muscles which will contract and expand to accommodate light in required amounts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab0ae76cdf1612f33c129a616a40343105045de0698905bece80fe8f1f98bff8.png] 

 
• The **cornea** is the outermost layer of the eye and focuses the entry of light into the eye.
 
• ​A **pupil** is a dark circle located at the centre of the iris. It will adjust itself to the amount of light entering the eye.
 
• The** eye lens **adjusts its shape and thickness as required to help focus on the retina.
 
• The** retina** is the light-sensitive membrane behind the eye where the image is formed.
 
• The **visual signals **regarding the image formed are transmitted to the brain in the form of electrical signals through the optic nerves.

questions.question: Which of the following statements about forests in INCORRECT?

options.text: In a forest, trees form the uppermost layer of vegetation.
Forests protect the soil from erosion.
In a forest, shrubs form the lowest layer of vegetation.
Forests influence climate, water cycle and air quality.

questions.solution:
**The correct answer is 'In a forest, shrubs form the lowest layer of vegetation.'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Forest Vegetation Layers:**

 
 
• Forests have a structured layering of vegetation. The layers, from top to bottom, include the canopy, understory, herb layer, and the forest floor.
 
• The uppermost layer is the **canopy**, formed by the crowns of tall trees.
 
• The **understory** is beneath the canopy and consists of smaller trees and shrubs.
 
• The **herb layer** is closer to the ground and includes grasses, ferns, wildflowers, and other herbaceous plants.
 
• The **forest floor** is the bottom layer, consisting of decomposing leaves, twigs, and organic matter.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Trees Form the Uppermost Layer:**

 
 
• Trees forming the uppermost layer of vegetation create the forest canopy, which is crucial for various ecological functions including providing habitat and influencing microclimate.
 
 
 
• **Forests and Soil Erosion:**
 
 
• Forests play a significant role in protecting soil from erosion through their root systems and ground cover, which stabilize the soil and prevent runoff.
 
 
 
• **Forests Influence Climate, Water Cycle, and Air Quality:**
 
 
• Forests have a major impact on the climate by absorbing carbon dioxide, influencing precipitation patterns, and through evapotranspiration processes.
 
• They also play a crucial role in the water cycle by facilitating the infiltration of water into the soil and maintaining watershed health.
 
• Forests contribute significantly to air quality by acting as carbon sinks, producing oxygen, and filtering pollutants from the air.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The lowest layer of vegetation in a forest is typically called the herb or ground layer, composed of low-growing non-woody plants like grasses, ferns, and mosses.
 
• Shrubs are usually found in the understory layer, which is above the ground layer but below the canopy.

questions.question: A ____ is an instrument used for measuring electrical potential difference between two points in an electric circuit.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**voltmeter**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• A Voltmeter is an instrument used to measure the potential difference in a circuit.
 
• A voltmeter is always connected in parallel in the circuit to measure the potential difference between two points.
 
• Unit of Potential Difference - Volt.
 
• A galvanometer can be converted into a voltmeter by connecting a large resistance in series.
 
• Voltmeter was invented by Hans Orested.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 __Name of the Instrument__
 __Functions/ Used for__
 
 

 **Barometer**
 Measuring atmospheric pressure.
 
 

 **Galvanometer**
 Measuring small electric current.
 
 

 **Ammeter**
 Measuring the strength of the electric current.
 
 

 Pyrometer
 Measuring very high temperature.
 
 

 Calorimeter
 Measuring quantities of heat.
 
 

 Polygraph
 Recording changes, simultaneously in physiological processes such as heartbeat, blood pressure, and respiration is also used as a lie detector.
 
 

 Electrocardiograph (ECG)
 Measuring movements of the heart.
 
 

 Dynamo
 Converts mechanical energy into electrical energy.
 
 

 Periscope
 Used for viewing objects above sea level.

questions.question: Article 57 of the Constitution of India states that _______.

options.text: A person who holds, or who has held, office as President shall, subject to the other provisions of this Constitution, be eligible for re-election to that office.
The executive power of the Union shall be vested in the President and shall be exercised by him either directly or through officers subordinate to him in accordance with this Constitution.
The President shall hold office for a term of five years from the date on which he enters upon his office.

The President shall be elected by the members of an electoral college consisting of— (a) the elected members of both Houses of Parliament, and (b) the elected members of the Legislative Assemblies of the States.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** **__**A person who holds, or who has held, office as President shall, subject to the other provisions of this Constitution, be eligible for re-election to that office.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 57 deals with the **eligibility conditions for the re-election of the President.**
 
• It states that a person who holds, or who has held, office as President shall, subject to the other provisions of this Constitution, be eligible for re-election to that office.
